properties.basis: Boundary inscriptions of Thutmose I and III on Hagr el-Merwa, Kurgus, '40km upstream of the Nile bend at Abu Hamed' (SARS; Davies 2003). GHA II p.261: 'Tuthmose I conquered Nubia beyond the Fourth Cataract'. Claimed limit, not administered land. SINGLE-SOURCE removed.

properties.label_detail_en: Thutmose I occupied "the whole reach between Kerma and Kurgus" (GHA II p.265). Southern frontier marker, not a drawn line. Point only; approximate edges not drawn (unsourced).
